messages.content: Read only factual statements in the current facts and question and return every coherent supported view. Identify the queried taxpayer and year; do not substitute a spouse or another person. Extract explicit blindness status at a stated date separately from source-native blindness events. Represent 'has been blind since' or equivalent continuing-state wording as ongoing_since; represent a bare onset with no supported continuation as onset_only; represent an expressly bounded period as closed_interval; and represent persistence only through an expressly supported date as ongoing_through. Do not invent recovery dates or arbitrary future permanence. Use [] only for a resolved finite channel containing no fact and null for unread or failed extraction. Include nonempty verbatim current facts/question witnesses in every view. Do not decide the year-end statutory condition, eligibility, applicability, entailment, contradiction, or any final answer.
